turns.question: In sessions between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that had both an add-to-cart and a checkout, what was the median number of minutes from the first add-to-cart to the checkout?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric, so I can't give a median time from add-to-cart to checkout. The closest metrics are cart_to_checkout_rate (share of cart sessions that checked out on the add-to-cart day or the next), cart_sessions and checkout_sessions, which I can compute for 20 September to 3 October 2026 if you want.
